question: The Subroto Cup inter-school football tournament is held annually in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Subroto Cup** is one of the most prestigious **inter-school football tournaments** held annually in India.
 
• It was established in **1960** and is named after **Air Marshal Subroto Mukerjee**, the first Indian Chief of the Air Staff.
 
• The tournament is organized by the **Indian Air Force** and primarily takes place in **New Delhi**, the capital city of India. *Hence, New Delhi is the correct answer.*
 
• The tournament attracts participation from **schools across the country**, and sometimes international teams are invited to compete.
 
• It is conducted in various age groups, including **U-14, U-17, and U-19**, for both boys and girls, ensuring broad inclusion and talent development.
 
• The matches are usually held in New Delhi at venues like the **Ambedkar Stadium** and other prominent locations suitable for football events.
 
• The Subroto Cup is regarded as a significant platform for **scouting young football talent** and promoting sports at the grassroots level.
 
• Prominent football personalities, including national and international players, are often invited to encourage participants and promote the sport.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is New Delhi.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History and Significance of Subroto Cup:**

 
 
• **Started in 1960** by the Indian Air Force, the tournament was envisioned to promote football among school students and inculcate a spirit of sportsmanship.
 
• Named after **Air Marshal Subroto Mukerjee**, the tournament reflects his passion for football and the need for sports in education.
 
 
 
• **Format and Participation:**
 
 
• The tournament features **school teams** from various states and union territories across India.
 
• Teams are categorized into age groups like **U-14, U-17, and U-19**, making it inclusive for young players of varying ages.
 
• International teams are occasionally invited to participate, adding diversity and global exposure to the event.
 
 
 
• **Importance for Football Development:**
 
 
• The Subroto Cup serves as a **platform for discovering football talent** at the grassroots level.
 
• Many players who excel in the tournament go on to represent India at the national and international levels.
 
 
 
• **Key Venues:**
 
 
• Matches are typically held at iconic locations like **Ambedkar Stadium**, ensuring high-quality facilities and audience engagement.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Contributions:**

 
 
• The tournament promotes **sports culture** among school children and provides a stepping stone for aspiring football players.
 
• **Subroto Cup alumni** include players who have represented India in international tournaments, showcasing its importance in football development.
 
 
 
• **Recent Developments:**
 
 
• **2023 Edition:** Featured participation from over 40 schools, including international teams, reinforcing its global appeal.
 
• **Special Awards:** Talent scouts and organizers often reward players with scholarships and training opportunities to nurture their skills further.
